approval_cards.action: grant a browser worker that can fetch an Etsy page as a buyer sees it: Marketplace Insights, search results and policy pages have no endpoint among the nine this application is authorised for
grant a model that can actually look at a picture, over the gallery URLs the sanctioned Etsy endpoint already returns
grant a model provider that can actually serve a request
grant roughly ten purchased competitor patterns
grant one person who has agreed to test a Brambleloop pattern, which needs outreach to real people and therefore an exit from shadow mode
grant an object-storage bucket and credential outside this provider, so a copy of the continuity archive survives losing the provider itself
grant a completed physical test of a Brambleloop pattern by whoever the testing protocol says performs one
grant an image-generation provider that conditions on reference images, because an identity lock is reference conditioning rather than a better prompt
grant a site or a Pinterest account this company can publish to, which only the owner can create
grant a listing that exists on the marketplace, which shadow mode forbids by design
grant real orders, which only a buyer can create -- not an owner action, and the reason this gate is in the same table as the ones that are
grant a benchmark shop outside the United States, which is a choice of shop rather than a credential or a capability
